title: ZED Agent Pipeline Catalog
description: Schema for pipeline-catalog.json. Declares official build, canary, production pipelines, EV2 service-group mapping, and the routing modes used by Steps 5, 7, 10 to pick which pipelines to trigger.

$schema.description: Pointer to this schema file for editor validation.

ev2ServiceTreeIds.description: Per-cloud Service Tree GUIDs (Prod / Fairfax / Mooncake / USNat / USSec). Same GUID may be reused across clouds.

ev2ServiceGroups.description: Map of pipeline key → EV2 ServiceGroup name (e.g., 'Microsoft.Azure.Backup.Service.Component.ACTIVE'). Used by Step 15 EV2 monitoring.

ev2CloudCoverage.description: Map of pipeline key → array of clouds that pipeline deploys to. MUST be derived per-pipeline from the pipeline's own reference run and script flags — never by copying a sibling. Cross-checked at trigger time against resolved script flags (L-15). Drives Step 15 dashboard rows.

templateParameters.description: Free-form key-value map. The agent forwards every key verbatim to ADO POST /_apis/build/builds.

canary.description: Map of canary pipeline key → entry. Keys are service-defined (e.g., 'SVC-SFMC', 'DM-EACAN').

production.description: Map of production pipeline key → entry. Keys are service-defined.

canaryRouting.description: How Steps 5 and 7 pick which canary pipelines to trigger. Optional — defaults to mode='static' if absent.

mode.description: static (default): trigger ALL entries under canary.*. cluster-type: query Kusto, parse DeploymentUnit suffix, route via clusterTypeMap.

clusterTypeMap.description: Required when mode='cluster-type'. Maps DeploymentUnit suffix (e.g., 'sfmc', 'sf') to a pipeline key under canary.* (string) OR a list of pipeline keys (array of strings). Use an array when multiple canary pipelines share the same cluster type (e.g., PROT-SFMC + DT-SFMC both serve 'sfmc' workloads).

productionRouting.description: How Step 10 (Roll-Forward — PROD pipelines targeting canary regions) picks which production pipelines to trigger. Optional — defaults to mode='static' if absent. Independent from canaryRouting because services often have asymmetric topology (e.g., 2 canary keys + 1 prod key).

mode.description: static (default): trigger ALL entries under production.*. cluster-type: query Kusto (same query as Step 5), route via clusterTypeMap.

clusterTypeMap.description: Required when mode='cluster-type'. Maps DeploymentUnit suffix to a pipeline key under production.* (string) OR a list of pipeline keys (array of strings).

privateStampUpgrade.description: Optional private stamp upgrade test — a side track kicked off at Step 5 (parallel to canary) and joined at Step 13 (SafeFly R2D waits for the owner's sign-off). Two sequential runs of the private stamp pipeline on ONE owner-chosen instance: leg 'last' (owner-supplied last build branch, port 1) then leg 'current' (release.currentBranch, port 2), both with the same ServiceOverrideSettings built from the owner-supplied queue name. Inputs are asked from the owner every release (never cached). Script: scripts/Invoke-PrivateStampUpgrade.ps1.

id.description: ADO pipeline definition id of the private stamp deployment pipeline.

sourceBranch.description: Ref whose YAML is queued for BOTH legs. Token {currentBranch} = release.currentBranch.

portSpan.description: Consecutive ports one deployment occupies (e.g. 2 when HTTP = HTTPS port + 1). The two owner ports must be at least this far apart.

templateParameters.description: Fixed templateParameters posted on both legs (values as strings). The four owner-driven parameters below are added on top.

parameterNames.description: Pipeline parameter names that receive the owner inputs.

serviceOverrideSettingsTemplate.description: Value for the serviceOverrides parameter. Token {queueName} = owner-supplied TeeWorkflowQueueName.

_examples.description: Optional reference shapes. Delete once real entries are populated.

yamlRepos.description: Per-repo base-branch overrides used by Group 11 YAML discovery (Read-PipelineYaml.ps1). Keyed by ADO repo name. Populated incrementally during setup-service group 11 whenever the agent encounters a YAML file (or extends: reference) in a repo it hasn't seen yet. Use this to keep YAML discovery deterministic across runs.

organization.description: Optional ADO org override when the YAML repo lives outside the service's primary org. Defaults to service-config.json → ado.organization.

project.description: Optional ADO project override. Defaults to service-config.json → ado.project.

clusterType.description: Optional cluster-type tag (e.g., 'sfmc', 'sfrp'). Used by canaryRouting/productionRouting when mode='cluster-type' as a per-pipeline declaration of which cluster type this pipeline serves (alternative to declaring it only in clusterTypeMap).

stampNameStyle.description: Controls which stamp field Resolve-TemplateParams.ps1 uses for {{*Stamps}} tokens. 'short' (default) → stampId (e.g. 'ea-01'); 'full' → stampName (e.g. 'ea-can02-prot1'). Different pipeline YAMLs expect different formats — SFMC's ParseStampId expects short IDs.

scheduleGuard.description: Canary pipelines only. Pauses this pipeline's own scheduled/ad-hoc deployments while the release bits must stay on its stamps: once ZED's Step 5 run of this pipeline SUCCEEDS, ZED sets pipeline variable <variable> = <disabledValue> on the definition; when Step 6 BVT is signed off (or completed/skipped by any path, and always before ZED triggers this pipeline again) ZED sets it back to <enabledValue>. Only reverted if ZED changed it. Script: scripts/Invoke-ScheduleGuard.ps1.

variable.description: Definition (Pipeline settings → Variables) variable name, e.g. 'enableSchedule'.

sdpType.description: EV2 SDP (Safe Deployment Practice) type for this pipeline. Overrides the resolver default when present. Common values: 'Express', 'Standard', 'Conservative'. When absent, defaults to 'Express' for backward compatibility with existing catalog entries.

requiresExclusions.description: When true, Resolve-TemplateParams.ps1 throws if {{excludeStamps}} would be empty for production scope. Prevents accidental global deploy when CCOA exclusions are expected but missing.

maxRegions.description: Maximum number of regions this pipeline should target. Resolve-TemplateParams.ps1 throws UNSAFE_REGION_SCOPE if the resolved region count exceeds this value for production scope. Set to the expected region count from a known-good reference run.

_learnedFrom.description: Provenance recorded by Group 11 wizard (setup-service). Skipped by the schema-driven empty-skeleton generator but accepted by the validator. Helps future re-runs detect drift (e.g., YAML sha changed).

runIds.description: ADO run IDs the agent learned templateParameters from (most-recent first, up to 3).

discoveryNotes.description: Auto-detected quirks observed during discovery (exclusion-list separator, stamp-name casing, reserved-token literal forms). Free-form owner annotations also welcome.

paramFormat.description: Controls value formatting applied after token substitution. 'bare' (default): values emitted as-is (e.g., 'ea-01'). 'ps-array': wraps in PowerShell array notation (e.g., '@("ea-01")'). 'regions-wrapper': wraps in regions() with full Azure region names (e.g., 'regions(eastasia)').

extraParams.description: Parameters present in prior runs but NOT declared in the YAML. Surface to maintainers — likely stale.

_validated.description: Stamp recorded after a successful Phase 11.2 / 11.3 dry-run. Underscore-prefixed → wizard metadata, not config.

skipped.description: true when sub-identifier 11.discovery-only was used (no dry-run performed).

agentGaps.description: Free-text gap descriptions the agent could not resolve during discovery (e.g., 'parameter X has no prior value and no YAML default — owner supplied manually'). Empty array on clean discovery.
